name: PRINT_START
description: Macro called at the start of every print - heats bed and hotend, homes, and primes
gcode:
[gcode_macro PRINT_START]
gcode:
    {% set BED_TEMP = params.BED_TEMP|default(60)|float %}
    {% set EXTRUDER_TEMP = params.EXTRUDER_TEMP|default(200)|float %}
    # Start heating bed
    M140 S{BED_TEMP}
    # Home all axes
    G28
    # Wait for bed to reach temperature
    M190 S{BED_TEMP}
    # Set and wait for nozzle temperature
    M109 S{EXTRUDER_TEMP}
    # Prime line
    G92 E0
    G1 Z2.0 F3000
    G1 X0.1 Y20 Z0.3 F5000.0
    G1 X0.1 Y200.0 Z0.3 F1500.0 E15
    G1 X0.4 Y200.0 Z0.3 F5000.0
    G1 X0.4 Y20 Z0.3 F1500.0 E30
    G92 E0
    G1 Z2.0 F3000

name: PRINT_END
description: Macro called at the end of every print - retracts, parks, and cools down
gcode:
[gcode_macro PRINT_END]
gcode:
    # Turn off heaters
    TURN_OFF_HEATERS
    # Retract filament
    G91
    G1 E-2 F2700
    G1 E-2 Z5 F2400
    # Present print
    G90
    G1 X0 Y220 F3000
    # Turn off fans
    M106 S0
    # Disable steppers
    M84

name: CANCEL_PRINT
description: Safely cancels the current print job
gcode:
[gcode_macro CANCEL_PRINT]
rename_existing: BASE_CANCEL_PRINT
gcode:
    TURN_OFF_HEATERS
    G91
    G1 Z10 F600
    G90
    G1 X0 Y220 F6000
    M106 S0
    CLEAR_PAUSE
    SDCARD_RESET_FILE
    BASE_CANCEL_PRINT

name: PAUSE
description: Pauses the current print and parks the head
gcode:
[gcode_macro PAUSE]
rename_existing: BASE_PAUSE
gcode:
    {% set X = params.X|default(10)|float %}
    {% set Y = params.Y|default(10)|float %}
    {% set Z = params.Z|default(10)|float %}
    SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PAUSE_state
    BASE_PAUSE
    G91
    G1 Z{Z} F600
    G90
    G1 X{X} Y{Y} F6000

name: RESUME
gcode:
[gcode_macro RESUME]
rename_existing: BASE_RESUME
gcode:
    RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PAUSE_state MOVE=1
    BASE_RESUME
